_comment: Real-shaped records read from a live AbstractGateway 0.20.2 on 2026-11-07 (GET only), sanitized (texts and paths replaced): a Notes drain occurrence, a Notes capture session (abstractnote@0.3.0, two turns) from the watch and one from the web, a Code conversation on the loaded basic-agent 0.0.5, one recorded on basic-agent 0.0.1 (no longer loaded), and one whose bundle is gone; Notes' automations next to a person's. `views` are GET /runs/{id}/view (replay_view_v1) answers, built from a live capture view (texts replaced). `input_schemas` are GET /bundles/{bundle}/flows/{flow}/input_schema answers.

entrypoints.name: Process queued notes
entrypoints.description: Take queued notes by priority and understand them one at a time, within a count and time budget.

entrypoints.name: Ask your notes
entrypoints.description: Answer a question from the notes at the requested effort (quick, standard or deep). Also serves the chat agent contract: prompt in, response out.

entrypoints.name: Reflect on your notes
entrypoints.description: Gather open loops, contradictions, resurfacing material and anniversaries; choose what deserves attention and write it down as insights.

entrypoints.name: Consolidate your notes
entrypoints.description: Merge duplicate entries, refresh the groups and their names, refresh stale summaries and the then-and-now of what changed, then reflect; every stage reports its progress.
